# Example: Deploy Hello World

**User:** "Deploy a simple ubuntu hello world to test the network."

**Agent Action:**
```bash
# Assuming hello-world.json was generated by the architect
nosana job post --market gpu-micro -f hello-world.json --wait
```

**Console Output Parsing:**
```
Uploading to IPFS... Cmx...
Submitting to Solana... tx: 5Kj...
Job Address: 7A1B...
Status: QUEUED
Status: RUNNING
[container stdout] hello world
Status: COMPLETED
```

**Agent Response:**
"Deployment successful! The job ran to completion. You can review the transaction on Solana at `tx: 5Kj...`."
